match_date.rule: Metadata for prediction timing. Historical dates require an explicit pre-match elo_scaled; future/no-date predictions may use current Elo state.

neutral_venue.rule: Known true/false is honored; null means source did not provide venue truth and scheduled home/away is retained explicitly.

validation.unknown_team: reject unless explicit cold-start policy is configured
validation.future_date: allowed only for prediction; never mutates historical Elo state
